# dr_wav

`dr_wav.h` 0.14.6 from https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs (commit `35b5c392cc15`, 2026-10-30), unmodified.
Reads WAV and AIFF. `dr_flac.h` 0.13.4 from the same commit, unmodified, reads FLAC. Licence: public domain (Unlicense) or MIT No Attribution, at the user's choice; the
full text is at the end of the header.
